summary: Make lane host accounting ARC-aware and explain finite admission waits without stranding zero-holder queues

replay.detail: Queued finite requests re-evaluate when the existing host-memory observation changes; elapsed time alone never grants admission.

schema.detail: Membership observations expose optional blockedBy holder, hold, outside, reserve or fifo. Impossible footprints emit ResourceError code impossible; historical impossible-capacity refusals remain readable.

rules.detail: All lanes subtract MemTotal minus MemAvailable minus reclaimable ARC above c_min minus live lane anon+kernel usage as outside memory. Finite executions keep burst reserve only for live laned seats.

compatibility.detail: Missing blockedBy is readable. Existing resource-lane reader capability requirements remain in force; older daemons must be upgraded before consuming the new impossible refusal spelling.

downtime.detail: No resource process restart is required by the accounting change.

manual.detail: No priority classes, disk admission, shell CLI or external admission cutover is introduced.

recovery.detail: ARC-aware outside measurements wake blocked admission through the existing observation path, while membership custody and host holds remain authoritative.
